description: Na₄Mg(BiO₃)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.52 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.40 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.50 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form MgO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with eight equivalent BiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-59°. There is one shorter (1.97 Å) and three longer (2.01 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. Bi is bonded to six O atoms to form BiO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra and edges with three equivalent BiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.66 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and two equivalent Bi atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and two equivalent Bi atoms to form edge-sharing ONa₄Bi₂ octahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and two equivalent Bi atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and two equivalent Bi atoms.
